run_cluster_translator: run the cluster translator script to compute cross-model k-means alignment accuracy on ImageNet validation data
run_kmeans_alignment: run k-means cluster label alignment between pairs of pretrained vision models using majority vote mapping
run_vision_model_representations: run extraction of image representations from multiple pretrained vision models including ViT, ResNet, and DINO
run_label_mapping_save: run the script to save cross-model k-means label mappings as numpy arrays to the output directory
run_imagenet_val_split: run a random train-test split of the ImageNet validation dataset using a fixed random seed
